audit.whatIsWrong: Called TRICKY 7/10 on a 42.74% lane, and four chart rows disagreed with the packet and the already-audited mirror.
audit.why: Mirror and packet both read Sylas, then Heimerdinger for five rows, then Skill. My layers read Skill/H/H/Skill/Skill/H/H — including giving Sylas level 6, which the mirror denies.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3, 4 and 6 flipped in both layers as one atomic group; diff HARD at 7.5/10 with the matching phase whys rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 row was written as a Sylas takeover; no cooldown backed any spike.
audit.why: UPGRADE!!! is 100/85/70 and only empowers his next spell — stolen, it gives you one charged turret he walks away from. The real timers are the grenade at 11s flat and rockets at 11/10/9/8/7.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns, report[5].t, dosFull[0].d and mid; level 6 restated as still his.

audit.whatIsWrong: The grenade was called 'CH-2 Grenade (Stun)' with no cooldown, and its splash effect was never separated from the direct hit.
audit.why: Riot's name is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, cooldown 11 at every rank; a direct hit stuns, surrounding units are only slowed. That distinction is what makes 'dodge the centre' actionable rather than 'dodge the grenade'.
audit.corrected: Full name and the stun-versus-slow split written into report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2].text contains '(AATROX: H-28Q Apex Turret)' — another champion's key leaked into this matchup's prose.
audit.why: It is visible corruption on a paid page and reads as a copy-paste from an Aatroxentry.
audit.corrected: Rewritten as UPGRADE!!! empowering his next spell into an Apex turret.

edits.before: Levels 3 through 5 are when this lane cements itself as a loss. Heimerdinger has a full turret spread covering the wave, his W cooldown is short enough to pepper you every time you approach, and your E hook requires crossing through at least two turrets to reach him — they interrupt your combo AND deal real damage. His E grenade can stun you mid-dash, leaving you standing inside turrets with no target to hook and no W heal in flight. Play for safe CS, track his E grenade cooldown (it is his longest at early levels), and save your own E for escaping ganks rather than trading. At level 6 you steal his R, but UPGRADE mode on a turret is a zoning tool, not a direct damage ultimate — deploying his R in this lane gives you one charged turret that he can simply walk away from; it does not swing the matchup the way a Malphite or Sion R would.
edits.after: Levels 3 through 5 are when this lane cements itself as a loss. Heimerdinger has a full turret spread covering the wave, Hextech Micro-Rockets reach 1325 units on an 11-second cooldown at rank 1, and your E hook has to cross at least two turrets to reach him — they chip you the whole way in. His grenade stuns you mid-dash on a direct hit, leaving you standing inside turrets with no target to hook and no W heal in flight. Play for safe CS, count his grenade at a flat 11 seconds every rank, and save your own E for escaping ganks rather than trading. At level 6 you steal UPGRADE!!!, but it only empowers your next spell — on a turret that is a zoning tool, not a direct damage ultimate, and he simply walks away from the one charged turret it gives you; it does not swing the matchup the way a Malphite or Sion R would.
